Failure interleaving: drain suspended in radio.transmit(E); persistence thread hits terminal failure -\u003e clear() resolves E's reservation False; transmit completes on air -\u003e complete(E, True) finds E removed, set_result(True) is idempotent first-wins -\u003e send() returns False for a frame that was emitted -\u003e upper layer retransmits -\u003e duplicate frame on air. Outcome is timing-dependent (True may win if loop thread completes first). Fix: marshal the clear through loop.call_soon_threadsafe and acquire _tx_lock on the loop, or document/enforce loop-affinity for on_persistence_failure.
